title: Barge-in during the greeting or bedtime music writes through a null out_resume_offset (panic/reboot)
scenario: Greeting clip plays; child presses the main button; story_barge_in_poll() returns true; audio_play_story_file dereferences *out_resume_offset which the caller passed as nullptr → StoreProhibited panic → reboot and re-greet. Same for a press during bedtime music.
evidence: audio_io.cpp:551-553 guards only the initial reset; :640-641 unguarded write in the barge_in branch (:430 same in the stream variant); callers with nullptr: AregVoiceMvp.ino:1396 (greeting), :3092 (music); others pass &resume_offset (:1788-1790, 1817). Secondary: GREEN/RED press there leaves s_browse_request set (:527).
fix: if (out_resume_offset) *out_resume_offset = …; at :640 and :430; clear s_browse_request at the top of handle_story_session_once.

title: CS_MAX_STORIES=16 silently drops 4 of the 20 shipped stories (the last four alt endings)
scenario: ContentSync:Stories has 20 real rows (10 base + 10 alt, base first); cs_manifest_parse keeps the first 16; sutasan-alt, sutlik-orskan-alt, three-piglets-alt, ulik-alt never download; a factory card with all 20 shrinks to 16 on first sync.
evidence: content_sync_rules.h:46; content_sync_model.cpp:36-44; content_sync.cpp:1744-1749, 1784, 1802; appsettings.json ContentSync:Stories 20 real rows; ContentManifestService.cs:48; ContentSyncOptions.cs:393-398, 401-423; host probe cs_accepted_count(20)=16; content_report.cpp:28 320-byte buffer
fix: Raise CS_MAX_STORIES (24/32) with a bench heap check; widen browse_pick's heard mask (static_assert CS_MAX_STORIES<=16, uint16_t) to uint32_t; bump kStoriesBufLen.

title: Orphan sweep runs after s_games_index.clear(), so every game clip reads as unreferenced
scenario: orphanSweepEnabled on → after sync s_games_index cleared at :1898 → content_orphan_sweep_run() at :1909 → game_file_is_referenced() iterates an empty document → up to 20 game clips deleted per boot; churn.
fix: Move s_games_index.clear() after the orphan sweep block.

title: Heard-set is marked at playback START, so a paused first listen resumes into the ALT file at the base file's byte offset (once variant endings are enabled)
scenario: Latent (AREG_VARIANT_ENDINGS_ENABLED default 0). First listen of X marks heard at start; pause at byte N; resume re-resolves via the variant-aware resolver → X-alt → offset N applied to a different MP3.
fix: On resume (s_story_offset>0) resolve the base path, or record the chosen playback path per session.

title: Online session opens a listen window and records the child after the final (12th) turn, then exits silently
scenario: Turn 12 reply plays; LED red; child presses and answers; WAV built; then the for-condition online_session_turn_cap_reached(13,12) ends the loop and the payload is freed (:1216).
fix: Before opening the listen window check online_session_turn_cap_reached(turn_no+1, max) and break (ideally after a closing clip).

title: Sync verdict ignores voice/music/game clip failures and reports ok, deferring the retry 6 h instead of 5 min
scenario: One welcome clip fails: story_fail() sets partial, but the final verdict tests only the story counter; else branch set_status(ok), streak clears, next attempt 6 h. Early returns (:1738, :1753) never reset s_last_status.
fix: Return failed counts from the three clip syncs and include them in the verdict; reset status at entry.

title: write_index removes the .prev backup even when the primary index is already missing
scenario: Write #2's final rename fails (primary missing, .prev good); write #3 verifies .new then removes .prev before its rename; if that fails too both are gone → next boot re-downloads everything.
fix: Only remove/move .prev when the primary exists; else rename .new → primary directly.
